purpose: NOCTRA product gallery: one new overhead flatlay and two original model views for denim and jacket

assets.name: denim-flatlay
assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: square 1:1 ecommerce gallery main image. Input image 1 is a generated garment design reference only. Create a NEW genuine overhead flatlay photograph of these exact indigo blue high-rise wide-leg jeans lying flat on a very light cool-grey studio surface. Retain the broad straight legs, subtle blue wash, copper topstitching, five-pocket construction, silver waist button and clean unbranded finish. Waistband at top, both legs and hems complete and separated slightly; centered garment with ample equal margin all round. Material should look like realistic heavy denim. Soft directional studio light with a delicate contact shadow at garment edges. The jeans must truly lie on the surface, not look like a standing invisible mannequin or suspended ghost product. No person, body, mannequin, hanger, props, text, branding, logo or watermark. One image, no collage.
assets.visualQa: Inspected: complete unbranded garment, neutral studio background, appropriate flatlay or full-body model view; no visible logos, text or watermark.

assets.name: denim-model-1
assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: original portrait 4:5 ecommerce model gallery photo. Input image 1 is a generated garment design reference. Create a new full-body studio editorial photograph of an adult woman aged 26 with long dark-brown loose hair, natural face and confident relaxed expression wearing these exact indigo blue high-rise wide-leg jeans. Preserve the blue wash, copper stitching, five pockets, silver waist button and broad straight fit. Style with a plain minimal black fitted tee and simple black shoes; no logos. Front view, standing relaxed with weight on one leg, one hand loosely in front pocket, other arm resting naturally, gaze slightly beside camera. Jeans waistband and BOTH entire legs fully visible from waist to shoes; do not crop feet, hems, or head. Grey-white concrete studio wall and floor, understated contemporary streetwear mood, soft natural-looking editorial light, realistic denim drape and skin texture. Keep subject centered with breathing room for 4:5 image. No text, watermark, accessories covering jeans, brands or extra people. One image, no collage.
assets.visualQa: Inspected: complete unbranded garment, neutral studio background, appropriate flatlay or full-body model view; no visible logos, text or watermark.

assets.name: jacket-flatlay
assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: square 1:1 ecommerce gallery main image. Input image 1 is a generated garment design reference only. Create a NEW genuine overhead flatlay photograph of this exact unbranded black leather bomber jacket lying FLAT on a very light cool-grey studio surface. Keep drop shoulders, rounded roomy sleeves, black ribbed collar/cuffs/hem, clean silver central zipper and two diagonal slash pockets. Lay the front closed with zipper straight, sleeves angled a little outward, full collar, full hem and both cuffs visible, leather naturally spread on the surface with credible folds. Centered garment with ample equal margin all round. Soft studio lighting highlights subtle leather grain and delicate contact shadows. Must look like a garment resting on a tabletop, not a standing invisible mannequin or inflated garment. No person, body, mannequin, hanger, props, text, branding, logo or watermark. One image, no collage.
assets.visualQa: Inspected: complete unbranded garment, neutral studio background, appropriate flatlay or full-body model view; no visible logos, text or watermark.
